package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

func (store Store) GetPublishedGoalGraph(ctx context.Context, goalCode string) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	return store.getPublishedGoalGraph(ctx, `
SELECT goal_code, version, title, description, graph_version
FROM learning_goal_version
WHERE goal_code=$1 AND status='PUBLISHED'`, goalCode)
}

func (store Store) GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(
	ctx context.Context,
	goalCode string,
	goalVersion string,
	graphVersion string,
) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	return store.getPublishedGoalGraph(ctx, `
SELECT goal_code, version, title, description, graph_version
FROM learning_goal_version
WHERE goal_code=$1 AND version=$2 AND graph_version=$3 AND status='PUBLISHED'`, goalCode, goalVersion, graphVersion)
}

func (store Store) getPublishedGoalGraph(ctx context.Context, goalQuery string, goalArgs ...any) (domain.GoalGraph, error) {
	var graph domain.GoalGraph
	err := store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, goalQuery, goalArgs...).Scan(
		&graph.Goal.Code, &graph.Goal.Version, &graph.Goal.Title,
		&graph.Goal.Description, &graph.Goal.GraphVersion,
	)
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT gt.target_type, gt.target_key, gt.target_version, target.title, target.description,
       gt.module_code, gt.module_title, gt.module_order,
       gt.section_code, gt.section_title, gt.section_order,
       gt.lesson_code, gt.lesson_title, gt.lesson_excerpt, gt.lesson_order
FROM learning_goal_target gt
JOIN learning_target target
  ON target.target_type=gt.target_type
 AND target.target_key=gt.target_key
 AND target.target_version=gt.target_version
WHERE gt.goal_code=$1 AND gt.goal_version=$2
ORDER BY gt.module_order, gt.section_order, gt.lesson_order,
         gt.target_type, gt.target_key, gt.target_version`, graph.Goal.Code, graph.Goal.Version)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	graph.Targets = make([]domain.LearningTarget, 0)
	targetIndexes := make(map[string]int)
	for rows.Next() {
		var target domain.LearningTarget
		if err := rows.Scan(
			&target.Ref.Type, &target.Ref.Key, &target.Ref.Version, &target.Title, &target.Description,
			&target.ModuleCode, &target.ModuleTitle, &target.ModuleOrder,
			&target.SectionCode, &target.SectionTitle, &target.SectionOrder,
			&target.LessonCode, &target.LessonTitle, &target.LessonExcerpt, &target.LessonOrder,
		); err != nil {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
		}
		targetIndexes[domain.TargetIdentity(target.Ref)] = len(graph.Targets)
		graph.Targets = append(graph.Targets, target)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	prerequisiteRows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT prerequisite.target_type, prerequisite.target_key, prerequisite.target_version,
       prerequisite.prerequisite_type, prerequisite.prerequisite_key, prerequisite.prerequisite_version
FROM target_prerequisite prerequisite
JOIN learning_goal_target gt
  ON gt.target_type=prerequisite.target_type
 AND gt.target_key=prerequisite.target_key
 AND gt.target_version=prerequisite.target_version
WHERE gt.goal_code=$1 AND gt.goal_version=$2
ORDER BY prerequisite.target_type, prerequisite.target_key, prerequisite.target_version,
         prerequisite.prerequisite_type, prerequisite.prerequisite_key, prerequisite.prerequisite_version`,
		graph.Goal.Code, graph.Goal.Version,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	defer prerequisiteRows.Close()
	for prerequisiteRows.Next() {
		var target, prerequisite domain.TargetRef
		if err := prerequisiteRows.Scan(
			&target.Type, &target.Key, &target.Version,
			&prerequisite.Type, &prerequisite.Key, &prerequisite.Version,
		); err != nil {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
		}
		index, exists := targetIndexes[domain.TargetIdentity(target)]
		if !exists {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		graph.Targets[index].Prerequisites = append(graph.Targets[index].Prerequisites, prerequisite)
	}
	if err := prerequisiteRows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	transitionRows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `
SELECT transition.source_stack, transition.target_type, transition.target_key,
       transition.target_version, transition.similarity, transition.difference,
       transition.analogy_boundary, transition.common_mistakes_json
FROM transition_knowledge transition
JOIN learning_goal_target gt
  ON gt.target_type=transition.target_type
 AND gt.target_key=transition.target_key
 AND gt.target_version=transition.target_version
WHERE gt.goal_code=$1 AND gt.goal_version=$2
ORDER BY transition.source_stack, transition.target_type, transition.target_key, transition.target_version`,
		graph.Goal.Code, graph.Goal.Version,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	defer transitionRows.Close()
	graph.Transitions = make([]domain.TransitionKnowledge, 0)
	for transitionRows.Next() {
		var transition domain.TransitionKnowledge
		var mistakesJSON []byte
		if err := transitionRows.Scan(
			&transition.SourceStack, &transition.Target.Type, &transition.Target.Key,
			&transition.Target.Version, &transition.Similarity, &transition.Difference,
			&transition.AnalogyBoundary, &mistakesJSON,
		); err != nil {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(mistakesJSON, &transition.CommonMistakes); err != nil {
			return domain.GoalGraph{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid transition common mistakes: %v", domain.ErrValidation, err)
		}
		graph.Transitions = append(graph.Transitions, transition)
	}
	if err := transitionRows.Err(); err != nil {
		return domain.GoalGraph{}, err
	}
	return domain.NormalizeGoalGraph(graph)
}

var _ repository.GoalGraphRepository = Store{}
var _ repository.ReadinessGoalGraphRepository = Store{}
